prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic high-resolution menswear portrait of one original approved adult man in a clean minimalist indoor studio.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult man with voluminous textured hair, raised chin and confident runway expression. He wears an open pastel-green padded puffer jacket over a white sleeveless vest and loose white trousers, with one hand gripping the collar and the other in a pocket.
composition_elements: Centered portrait with body slightly angled and relaxed dominant attitude.
Subtle vertical panel wall offset to the right, soft neutral studio background and clean negative space.
Preserve puffer volume, white layers, hair texture, hand placement and pastel palette.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diagonal studio light with gentle fill, subtle highlights on the puffer and hair, natural shadows and refined modern atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 portrait, 85mm lens at f/4, sharp face, hair and textile detail, realistic skin texture, subtle grain, no text or watermark.
